config.theme.description: Colour scheme for diagram previews. Use "auto" to follow the VS Code colour theme, or choose "light" or "dark". If a diagram's theme, or the Azure icons or the C4 library it uses, would be hard to read, the extension switches that diagram to the other colour scheme.
config.logLevel.description: Minimum severity of rendering messages in the PlantUML Local output channel. This does not affect command logs, such as export messages. VS Code's log level for the channel also filters messages; to see debug messages, set both levels to "debug" or "trace".
config.exportDirectory.description: Folder for exported SVG and PNG files, relative to the Markdown or PlantUML file. Use "." to export to the same folder. Absolute paths and ".." are not allowed.
config.exportTheme.description: Colour scheme for exported SVG and PNG files, and for diagrams copied from the .puml preview. Use "light" (the default), "dark", or "preview" to follow the preview setting. If a diagram's theme, or the Azure icons or the C4 library it uses, would be hard to read, the extension switches that diagram to the other colour scheme.
config.exportPngScale.description: Size of exported PNG images, and of diagrams copied from the .puml preview: 1, 2, or 4 times the diagram's original size. Export and copy stop if an image would exceed 8192 pixels in width or height, or 16 million pixels in total. Images are not resized automatically.
config.hideExportedImages.description: Hide exported images marked with #plantuml-local in the Markdown preview to avoid showing the same diagram twice. Turn this off to check the exported images.
config.preview.updateMode.description: When to refresh diagrams in Markdown and PlantUML previews: "onChange" as you type, "onSave" when you save, or "manual" when you run PlantUML Local: Clear Render Cache and Re-render. Until then, the preview shows the previous diagram with a notice that it is out of date. New diagrams are always rendered, and exports always use the current source.
config.diagnostics.enabled.description: Show diagram errors and warnings from open Markdown and PlantUML files in the Problems panel, even when no preview is open. This includes unsupported syntax and content that PlantUML leaves out of the diagram.
config.codeLens.enabled.description: Show Preview, Export SVG and Export PNG above each diagram in Markdown and PlantUML files. The editor.codeLens setting must also be on.
config.styleHelp.enabled.description: Suggest the names and values of common style properties and of a few skinparam names in Markdown and PlantUML files, and explain them on hover. Other suggestions and hovers are not affected.
config.includePaths.description: Additional folders to search for local !include files, after the folder containing the file with the directive. Specify up to 16 paths relative to the workspace folder. These folders are searched for paths such as common.puml or styles/common.puml; paths starting with ./ or ../ are resolved only relative to the file with the directive. Includes require a trusted workspace and must stay within the document's workspace folder.
config.workspaceSymbols.enabled.descript: List the named diagrams, the declared elements, and the procedures, functions and macros of the Markdown and PlantUML files in this folder in Go to Symbol in Workspace (Ctrl+T). The files are read when you first type a search, and only in a trusted workspace.
config.workspaceSymbols.exclude.descript: Paths to leave out of Go to Symbol in Workspace, relative to the workspace folder: up to 32 patterns of up to 256 characters each. Separate folders with /. In a folder or file name, ? matches one character and * any number of them; ** on its own between two / matches any number of folders. For example, docs/** leaves out the docs folder and everything in it, and **/*.wsd every .wsd file. Patterns are case-sensitive. .git, .hg, .svn, node_modules, dist and build are always left out, and links are never followed. If a pattern is not valid, the folder is not searched until it is fixed.
config.rename.enabled.description: Rename the alias of a sequence diagram's participant with Rename Symbol (F2) in the code blocks of Markdown files: the declaration that gives it with as, and every place the diagram uses it. Labels, notes and comments are left as they are. Only a diagram whose every line is of a form the rename reads is renamed in. PlantUML files are not supported.
capability.untrustedWorkspaces.descripti: Diagrams can be previewed in Restricted Mode. Including workspace files, searching them with Go to Symbol in Workspace and exporting diagrams require a trusted workspace. Rendering runs locally without network access.
capability.virtualWorkspaces.description: Local !include directives and Go to Symbol in Workspace require files on disk and are not available in virtual workspaces. Participant aliases are renamed only in Markdown files on disk and in untitled Markdown files.
view.dependencies.name: Diagram Dependencies
view.dependencies.welcome: Open a Markdown or PlantUML file to list the files its diagrams include, as they were last drawn.
